patterns.note: Asymmetrical, gallery-like composition with large, unconstrained imagery and generous negative space, often breaking conventional grid lines.
Distinctive pairing of a bold, modern sans-serif for primary branding and a contrasting handwritten script for a secondary tagline.
High-contrast black and white base palette, with natural textures and product photography providing subtle color accents.
A transforming sticky header that condenses and rearranges elements on scroll, combined with a subtle parallax effect on the hero image.
Use of full-width content blocks that alternate between image-heavy and text-heavy layouts, often featuring a single dominant visual element.

technique_notes: The header implements a scroll-triggered transformation where the main logo scales down and repositions, a secondary tagline fades out, and the navigation shifts from a full-height sidebar to a compact inline menu within a sticky top bar. Simultaneously, the hero image moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a parallax depth effect.
Content sections frequently feature large, uncropped images or objects that break the conventional grid, often paired with minimal text, creating an exhibition-like presentation.

The design leverages a strong typographic hierarchy by contrasting an oversized, bold sans-serif for the primary brand with a whimsical, handwritten script for a supporting message, all set against a clean, readable sans-serif for body text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) paired with a distinctive, handwritten script for a secondary tagline, and a clean, readable sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners for all interactive elements, images, and containers
design_tokens.spacing: very airy in the hero and between major sections, creating a gallery-like presentation; content within feature blocks is more balanced

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost brutalist use of a natural object (the large rock) as the hero, juxtaposed with a playful, handwritten script tagline and an otherwise minimal, high-contrast aesthetic. This combination creates a unique blend of raw authenticity and refined artistic curation.
